老李家的堂屋内！！

李老屯坐在主位上抽着旱烟，脸上满是愁容，他是万万没有想到，老三竟然敢忤逆自己的话。

真是反了天！！

老三的突然反抗，对于这个家来说，还是有不小的影响。

家中自然缺了几个劳动力。

以后家里的活，大家都要多分担一些了。

“爹，老三真不是个东西，竟敢和爹这么说话，要我说，今天晚上就应该把他赶出去。”

李二奎是个暴脾气，率先开口训斥道。

“还有李青山那个狼崽子，竟敢打我们，要不是他偷袭，倒在地上的一定是他。”

“娘的，疼死我了。”

李青余摸着自己，现在还有些扭痛的小腹道。

“爹，咱们老李家在石溪村那也是大家，有头有脸的，从来就没有受到过这种窝囊气，无论如何，都要给三房一个教训，否则以后，父亲您出去在外，还怎么抬起头来？”

李大奎也开口拱火道。

“青书，你是咱们家最有文化的。”

“你来说说，这件事情应该怎么办？”

李老屯的目光看向了自己的大孙子，开口问道。

“爷，我爹说得对，咱们肯定得好好教训一番三房，否则咱们在村子里都抬不起头。”

“但是，李青山这小子和李财他们关系不错，咱们要是动李青山，他们家那两个儿子肯定要帮忙，咱们家虽然不怕，但免不了两败俱伤，让外人看了笑话。”

“要我说，咱们现在，什么都不需要去做。”

“明日，爷爷你就去和李青山去政府将户口分开，将李青山一家子全部赶出去。”

“爹，你想一想1”

“咱们村子得赵占山这个老猎户，家中还有不少得耕地，天天上山打猎，也就刚好够自己和女儿平日里日常吃喝开销。”

“李青山这小子一个人上山打猎，家中还没有耕地种。”

“难不成，他一个人还能养活全家四口人不成？”

“这次，这小子之所以打这么多猎物，也不过是运气使然，但运气不可能一直眷顾他。”

“说不得下次上山，就死在了山上呢！”

“到时候！”

“三叔家中没了吃的，还不得乖乖来求爷爷，咱们到时候再好好惩治他们一番，而且赵贵家的那个宅子，咱们也可以趁机收到咱们的手中。”

“有了三叔一家子后，咱们老李家的农活也就有人干了。”

“最关键的是，三叔没了儿子，没了子嗣！”

“嘿，到时候还不得任由我们这几个侄子拿捏？”

李青书嘴角挑起一丝坏笑，开口道。

“嗯，有道理！”李老屯点了点头，继续道：“那咱们现在，就什么都不做吗？”

“爷，咱们现在要做的，就是让李青山尽快上山，多上山，多去冒险，你想想他们搬去了赵贵家后，最为迫切需要什么？”李青书开口问道。

“需要什么？”李老屯好奇道。

“婆娘啊！”

“李青山现在也老大不小了，咱们想办法给他说个婆娘，姑娘家不得要彩礼吗？”

“要彩礼，不就得上山去打猎吗？”

“只要去打猎，李青山就有可能死在山上，咱们也就省了很多麻烦不是吗。”

李青山坏笑道。

“嗯，好办法！”李老屯点头应下，旋即看向自己得两个儿媳妇和自己的老婆子道：“这件事情，你们有没有什么办法？”

“爹，我娘家倒是有个侄女，如今也到了年纪，不妨给李青山说一说试试。”

二伯母想了想后，开口道。

“行！”

“这两天，你带些东西回一趟娘家，问一问意思，看看能不能行！”

“这件事情你要是做成了。”

“那可就是咱们老李家的功臣了。”

In the main room of Lao Li's family!!

Li Laotun sat on the main seat and smoked a dry cigarette, with a sad look on his face. He never expected that the third child would dare to disobey his words.

What a rebellion!!

The sudden resistance of the third child still has a big impact on this family.

Naturally, the family is short of several laborers.

From now on, everyone will have to share more of the work at home.

"Dad, the third child is really nothing. He dares to talk to dad like that. If you ask me, I should kick him out tonight."

Li Erkui had a bad temper and was the first to scold him.

"And that wolf bastard Li Qingshan dared to hit us. If he hadn't made a sneak attack, he would have fallen to the ground."

"Damn, it hurts me so much."

Li Qingyu touched his lower abdomen, which was still a little painful.

"Dad, our Lao Li family is a big family in Shixi Village. We are respectable people. We have never been subjected to this kind of cowardice. No matter what, we must teach the third room a lesson. Otherwise, in the future, father, how can you hold your head up when you go out?"

Li Dakui also opened his mouth and said Gonghuo.

"Qingshu, you are the most educated in our family."

"Tell me, what should we do about this matter?"

Li Laotun looked at his eldest grandson and asked.

"Master, my father is right, we must teach Sanfang a lesson, otherwise we won't be able to hold our heads high in the village."

"However, Li Qingshan has a good relationship with Li Cai and the others. If we try to touch Li Qingshan, their two sons will definitely help. Although our family is not afraid, we will inevitably suffer losses and make outsiders laugh."

"Let me tell you, we don't need to do anything now."

"Tomorrow, grandpa, you and Li Qingshan will go to the government to separate the household registrations and drive out Li Qingshan's family."

"Dad, think about it1"

"Zhao Zhanshan, an old hunter in our village, still has a lot of farmland at home. He goes to the mountains to hunt every day, which is just enough for me and my daughter to eat and drink on a daily basis."

"This kid Li Qingshan went up to the mountains to hunt alone. He doesn't have any land for farming at home."

"Is it possible that he can support a family of four by himself?"

"This time, the reason why this kid killed so many prey was just luck, but luck can't always favor him."

"I wonder if I will die on the mountain next time!"

"That's when!"

"Third uncle has no food at home, so he has to come and beg grandpa obediently. We will punish them well when the time comes, and we can also take the opportunity to take the Zhao Gui family's house into our hands."

"After we have our third uncle and his family, someone will do the farm work for our old Li family."

"The most important thing is that the third uncle has no son or heir!"

"Hey, when the time comes, you won't be able to let us nephews manipulate you?"

Li Qingshu raised a smirk on his lips and said.

"Well, that makes sense!" Li Laotun nodded and continued: "Then let's do nothing now?"

"Master, what we have to do now is to get Li Qingshan up the mountain as soon as possible, go up the mountain more, and have more adventures. Think about what they need most urgently after they move to Zhao Gui's house?" Li Qingshu asked.

"What do you need?" Li Laotun asked curiously.

"Mother-in-law!"

"Li Qingshan is quite old now. Let's find a way to find a wife for him. Don't we have to ask for a bride price from the girl's family?"

"If you want a bride price, don't you have to go hunting in the mountains?"

"As long as we go hunting, Li Qingshan may die on the mountain, and we will save a lot of trouble, right?"

Li Qingshan said with a evil smile.

"Well, that's a good idea!" Li Laotun nodded in agreement, then looked at his two daughters-in-law and his old wife and said, "Is there anything you can do about this matter?"

"Dad, I do have a niece in my mother's family. Now she is old enough. You might as well tell Li Qingshan about it."

The second aunt thought for a while and then said.

"Okay!"

"In the next two days, take some things back to your parents' house, ask what they mean, and see if you can do it!"

"If you can do this."

"That's the hero of our old Li family."
